## kb_to_source

- Every normative sentence in the 4 policies' 27 documents and the base documents listed above has a source atom (rule, eligibility contract, temporal basis counting rule, measure or variant parameter). Derived clarifications checked: "a credit posted on the filing date itself is not posted after it" (compute `DAYS > 0`); "the latest denial date on the claim" (compute `LATEST`); "taken across the coverage" (coverage-wide SUM); "the denial date is read from the denial line" (anchor_source); "the code is read from the denial line ... a caller's description does not replace it" (evidence authority system_record). All entailed.
- No added confirmation, review, notification or procedure step was found.
- Cross-problem operational guidance: none. Each tool name occurs only in its own hub (mechanical scan over all 74 docs); no "if unmet, first call …".
- World state written as policy fact: none. A scan for this task's payer names, claim numbers, customer names and amounts found only unrelated hypothetical figures.
- Additions/rewrites/omissions: none attributable to the rendering.

Policy-side notes (recorded, not KB verdicts):
- N1. For `coverage_ext_primary_information_correction` (and likewise the authorization and coordination corrections), `baseline.rule` says "resubmits the denial's amount in full", but `invoice_reduction` is a non-factor compute binding that, at the invoice-minimum factor's baseline (10.00; coordination 15.00), takes billing-error corrections off. The computation document follows the compute ("come off once their total reaches the invoice minimum of 10.00 USD"). The source's fall-back is therefore not "in full" when corrections reach the standard minimum. Not triggered in this task (7.00 < 10.00; `baseline_result` 172.0).
- N3. The source makes `plan_portion`, `interest`, `net_exposure`, `member_interest` and `result` non-factor bindings that reference factor-decided terms. So each computation document has to name the interest / underpayment / hold / assistance slots with their factor-baseline values ("no interest days run", "Nothing is added", "the member portion stands as figured", "an assistance percent of zero"). This comes from how the source is built, not from the rendering.
